description:
After scoring twice earlier in the night—including the late third-period equalizer—defenseman Simon Nemec completed his first career NHL hat trick by playing hero in overtime. Jacob Markstrom started the play with a perfect stretch pass that sent Nemec in alone, and the young blueliner ripped a wrist shot into the net just before the backcheck closed in. Nemec is now in his third season with the Devils.

description:
Marc-Andre Fleury joined the Chicago Blackhawks in July 2021, bringing championship experience and steady leadership to a team in transition. On February 18, 2022, Fleury stood tall against the Dallas Stars, stopping all 29 shots in a hard-fought 1–0 shootout loss at the United Center. One of his standout moments came in the final seconds of the second period, when he made an incredible glove save to deny Roope Hintz all alone in front of the net. Despite the loss, his performance was a clear reminder of why he was one of the league’s most dependable goaltenders throughout his career. Fleury appeared in 45 games that season before being traded to the Minnesota Wild in March 2022.

description:
In his third NHL season, Leo Carlsson is showing exactly why the Ducks drafted him second overall in 2023. Facing a strong Vegas Golden Knights team, he battles along the wall, wins the puck, and moves it to Troy Terry before driving to the net. Terry feeds it back, and Carlsson pulls it to his backhand and lifts it far side for a terrific finish. He later added another goal and an assist in Anaheim’s overtime win.

description:
A clutch performer who’s won at every level, Sidney Crosby put on a show in Game 2 against Ottawa during the 2010 playoffs. With the score tied and under five minutes left, Crosby battled endlessly behind the net, protecting the puck and shaking off an Ottawa defender. He finally slipped it back to the point, where Kris Letang corralled the pass and ripped a slapshot for the game-winner. Crosby’s relentless effort and elite puck protection helped Pittsburgh earn the split on home ice, leading to a series win in six. The franchise’s all-time assists leader, Crosby also ranks inside the NHL’s Top 10 all-time in assists.
